raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred that because Sobhuza I is also known as Ngwane IV, his father (and thus Tsandzile Ndwandwe’s father-in-law) must be Ngwane III, conflating royal numeration/predecessor with the paternal relationship. This ignored the sourced evidence that Sobhuza I’s father is Ndvungunye (also known as Zikodze), leading to a misidentification of the father-in-law.
